methods.ap: Original full COCO AP, unchanged raw predictions; matching recomputed on CPU to expose diagnostics; exact agreement with saved reports required.
methods.matched_gt: COCO all-area per-class greedy matches at IoU .50/.75, not language query coverage. Small subgroup here filters GT area<=1024 from all-area matching; AP-small itself follows COCO area-specific ignore matching.
methods.best_iou: Independent maximum over saved top100 detections, not one-to-one; same/other class separated.
methods.fp_outcomes: At IoU .50/.75: ignored, TP, duplicate same-class overlap, wrong-class overlap, max overlap>=.1 localization/mixed, otherwise background/unannotated. These are descriptive, not causal counterfactual AP gains.
methods.high_score: Fixed score>=.5 diagnostic slice; no threshold search or language candidate selection.
methods.sizes: COCO area ranges including boundary overlap; areas in original-image pixels.
methods.queries: No language queries read; GT labels used only for diagnostics, never candidate production.
